description: ORD-226 Phase 2 bindings validation slice. Covers exactly the fail-closed bindings validator, its fm-profile.sh wiring, and the colocated validator tests. The template and a runtime currently differ in unrelated scripts; this manifest deliberately deploys only these three artifacts so the slice never carries unrelated changes. The production-local bindings, metadata sidecar, and fingerprint sidecar under state/ are never listed here and are never deployed.
